description: Fixed few-shot LIBERO subset: 3 randomly sampled demonstration episodes per task (random.Random(seed=42), tasks in ascending task_index order, candidates sorted by episode_index). Consumed by LIBEROLeRobotDataset(episode_subset_path=...).

0.task: turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it

1.task: put both the alphabet soup and the tomato sauce in the basket

2.task: put the white mug on the left plate and put the yellow and white mug on the right plate

3.task: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

4.task: pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

5.task: put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it

6.task: put the white mug on the plate and put the chocolate pudding to the right of the plate

7.task: put both the cream cheese box and the butter in the basket

8.task: put both moka pots on the stove

9.task: put both the alphabet soup and the cream cheese box in the basket
